🧠 **NeuroNest — The Agent-First IDE**

NeuroNest is an AI-powered agentic IDE built on Electron that orchestrates 117+ specialized AI agents across 13 departments — with a dual-layer firewall, real-time knowledge graph, local-first inference, and five swarm execution topologies. No cloud required.

**From prompt to production.** NeuroNest decomposes objectives, routes work across expert agents, and synthesizes cross-team outputs into a single coherent result — start to finish.

• Built by **NETGV AI**
• Available on macOS 13+, Windows 11, and Ubuntu 22.04+
• Free Community tier — no credit card required

🌐 https://neuronest.cc

💰 **NeuroNest Pricing**

• **Community** — Free forever. No credit card.
  ↳ 117+ AI agents, swarm orchestration, multi-model support, knowledge graphs, firewall engine, all channels, skills & templates, local auth

• **Professional** — $29/mo per workspace
  ↳ Everything in Community + cloud sync & backup, team collaboration, priority model access, advanced analytics, custom agent training, API access, email support

• **Enterprise** — Custom pricing
  ↳ Everything in Professional + SSO/SAML auth, enhanced guardrails & firewall, audit logging, role-based access, SLA guarantee, dedicated support, custom integrations

⬇️ Download free: https://neuronest.cc/download

🤖 **117+ Agents Across 13 Departments**

• **Engineering** (15) — code architecture, backend, frontend, API design, refactors
• **Security** (8) — threat modeling, pen testing, dependency audits, SAST/DAST
• **Data** (10) — ML models, analytics, feature engineering, evaluation
• **DevOps** (8) — CI/CD, cloud architecture, IaC, observability
• **Design** (6) — UX, UI engineering, design systems, accessibility
• **QA** (6) — test planning, property-based testing, mutation runs
• **Product** (5) — PRDs, roadmaps, competitive scouting
• **Research** (5) — literature surveys, hypothesis formation
• **Mobile** (4) — iOS, Android, cross-platform
• **Blockchain** (4) — smart contracts, DeFi, Web3
• **AI/ML** (6) — NLP, computer vision, fine-tuning
• **Infrastructure** (5) — databases, networking, scalability
• **NeuroNest Orchestration** (1) — central coordinator

Each agent has a defined specialty, system prompt, and skill set. The orchestrator selects the right agents for every task automatically.

⬇️ **Platforms & System Requirements**

**Supported Platforms:**
• macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon or Intel)
• Windows 11
• Ubuntu 22.04+ (AppImage)

**Minimum Requirements:**
• 4 CPU cores, 8 GB RAM, 20 GB disk

**Recommended:**
• Apple M3 Max or GPU-enabled, 32+ GB RAM, SSD 100 GB+

⬇️ Download: https://neuronest.cc/download

🔒 **Security & Privacy**

• **Local-first architecture** — all inference stays on your hardware. No cloud dependency.
• **Dual-layer firewall** — regex at the perimeter (<10ms), LLM judge at the gate (~200ms)
• **4 security tiers** — sanitization, prompt injection detection, secrets scanning, policy enforcement
• **Human-in-the-loop** — outbound messages, shell commands, and file writes require approval
• **Secrets in keychain** — API keys stored in macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager
• **Full audit trail** — every firewall decision, agent call, and channel send is logged
• **GDPR & CCPA ready** — no personal data leaves the workstation
• **Sandbox isolation** — every agent task runs in a directory-rooted sandbox

🔐 Security brief: https://neuronest.cc/security

🔌 **11 AI Providers Supported**

**Cloud API:**
• OpenAI
• Anthropic
• Google Gemini
• DeepSeek
• Grok (xAI)
• Mistral
• NVIDIA NIM
• Groq

**Local Inference (fully offline):**
• Ollama
• llama.cpp
• OpenMythos

Provider-agnostic architecture — swap models without touching agent code. Streaming via SSE, token usage tracking, automatic model listing, and API key validation.

**Run fully offline** with Ollama or llama.cpp. 75 tok/s on Apple M3 Max with 35B models.

⚡ **Performance Benchmarks**

• **70% shorter development cycles** — compared to manual coding workflows
• **75 tokens/second** — local inference on Apple M3 Max (35B models)
• **50,000 graph nodes** — interactive knowledge graph visualization (Cytoscape.js)
• **2-second summaries** — real-time project context summarization

NeuroNest is optimized for speed at every layer — from the regex firewall (<10ms) to streaming agent responses via SSE.

🔀 **Five Execution Topologies**

• **Sequential** — dependent tasks flow step-by-step (design → implement → test)
• **Star** — one master agent coordinates specialist workers
• **Hierarchical** — multi-level decomposition for large objectives
• **Mesh** — peer agents exchange partial results and converge
• **Swarm** — all agents vote or compete independently for the best answer

The orchestrator picks the right topology for every task automatically based on task complexity, dependencies, and agent availability.

💬 **Channel Hub — 6 Integrations**

All incoming messages are firewall-scanned, processed through the AI pipeline, then the response is sent back to the originating channel.

• **Slack** (Bolt OAuth)
• **Discord** (discord.js)
• **Telegram** (Grammy Bot API)
• **WhatsApp** (Cloud API)
• **Email** (Nodemailer, send-only)
• **GitHub** (REST API)

Every outbound message routes through the same security gate. Your approval is required before send.

🏢 **Built by NETGV AI**

NeuroNest is developed by **NETGV AI** — focused on building intelligent developer tools that bring agentic AI to the software development lifecycle.

• Product: NeuroNest — The Agent-First IDE
• Website: https://neuronest.cc
• Architecture: Electron + Node.js + TypeScript
• Philosophy: Local-first, privacy-respecting, agent-orchestrated development

⚡ **Key Capabilities**

• **Orchestration** — 5 topologies: sequential, star, hierarchy, mesh, swarm
• **ZERA Optimizer** — rewrites prompts for clarity before execution
• **Knowledge Graph** — live queryable graph of your codebase (50k nodes)
• **Channel Hub** — Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, Email, GitHub
• **Smart Router** — automatic failover, long-context routing, task-based model selection
• **Visual Diff Review** — accept/reject AI changes individually
• **Model Packs** — switch entire LLM configs in one click
• **Autonomy Levels** — from fully supervised to fully autonomous
• **Plan Version Control** — branch and rewind agent plans
• **Kanban Board** — agent tasks as cards
• **50+ AI features** — brainstorm mode, second opinion, crash recovery, edit lock, project memory, MCP integration, and more

📚 Full docs: https://neuronest.cc/docs

🧠 **Knowledge Graph**

NeuroNest builds a live, queryable graph of every file, function, class, and relationship in your project — updated incrementally as you work.

• Up to **50,000 nodes** interactive (Cytoscape.js)
• Tracks: imports, function calls, class inheritance, interface implementations, data flow
• Languages: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, Rust, C++
• Query: `type="class" and depends_on="auth.ts"`
• Export: JSON, GraphML, PNG, SVG

The knowledge graph powers grounding enforcement — ensuring agent responses are anchored to real project structure.
